operations.section: TD-13 — Recycling refunds actual deployment RP only
operations.old: KEEP actual enemy destruction, your own device, one minute after combat, once per short rest, consume its usable debris and return at most1RP actually paid to **deploy that same device**. Crafting GP, ingredients, dawn charges, service packs, encoding, field repairs, Dissonance routing and later Overcharge RP are not deployment RP. These43 crafted devices have no innate RP deployment cost, so they create **zero refundable deployment RP** through this card. Do not consume a valuable wreck merely by falsely asserting that its price is RP; admission must identify an actual eligible prior paid deployment. Deliberate sacrifice, copied objects and repeated debris claims do not qualify. No unspecified material salvage percentage is added by the class's legacy name.

operations.section: End a turn, end an encounter, finish a rest: first paragraph
operations.old: At a regular turn boundary, resolve actual deadlines and tick round-recharge counters under the [timing rules](../mechanics/CLASS_PLAYTEST_RULES.md#action-and-timing-limits). An extra Action or extra turn does not supply another regular-turn recharge tick. A named counter can receive at most one reset/shortening per round, and a reset is neither a resource refill nor an extra activation.
operations.replacement: Resolve each deadline at its actual source-defined start, end or elapsed-time endpoint. Tick round-recharge counters once at the start of the owner's regular turn, even when the owner cannot act, under the [timing rules](../mechanics/CLASS_PLAYTEST_RULES.md#action-and-timing-limits). A turn end, extra Action or extra turn does not supply another regular-turn recharge tick. Outside initiative, use the same source's six-second elapsed-time procedure without double counting a boundary. Only a positive counter can be reset or shortened, at most once per named ability per numbered round; a reset is neither a resource refill nor an extra activation.
operations.authorization: APPROVED VERBATIM; not applied to the user repository by this package
